import math
import json

with open('/work/poses.json') as f:
    poses = json.load(f)

def get_bearing(frame_id, u):
    pose = poses[str(frame_id)]
    h_rad = math.radians(pose['h'])
    alpha = math.atan2(u - 255.5, 256.0)
    theta = h_rad + alpha
    return pose['x'], pose['y'], theta

def intersect_rays(x1, y1, th1, x2, y2, th2):
    dx1, dy1 = math.sin(th1), math.cos(th1)
    dx2, dy2 = math.sin(th2), math.cos(th2)
    det = -dx1 * dy2 + dy1 * dx2
    if abs(det) < 1e-4:
        return None
    tx = x2 - x1
    ty = y2 - y1
    t1 = (-dy2 * tx + dx2 * ty) / det
    t2 = (-dy1 * tx + dx1 * ty) / det
    px = x1 + t1 * dx1
    py = y1 + t1 * dy1
    return px, py, t1, t2

# 1. COUCH (blue)
# Frame 1: center_x = 372.3
# Frame 14: center_x = 406.5
# Frame 19: center_x = 295.9
x1, y1, th1 = get_bearing(1, 372.3)
x14, y14, th14 = get_bearing(14, 406.5)
x19, y19, th19 = get_bearing(19, 295.9)
print("Couch (1 & 14):", intersect_rays(x1, y1, th1, x14, y14, th14))
print("Couch (1 & 19):", intersect_rays(x1, y1, th1, x19, y19, th19))
print("Couch (14 & 19):", intersect_rays(x14, y14, th14, x19, y19, th19))

# 2. CHAIR 1 (back left chair, next to plant 1)
# Frame 1: u = 142.4
# Frame 8: u = 120.2
# Frame 14: u = 105.7
# Frame 15: u = 255.6
x1_c1, y1_c1, th1_c1 = get_bearing(1, 142.4)
x14_c1, y14_c1, th14_c1 = get_bearing(14, 105.7)
x15_c1, y15_c1, th15_c1 = get_bearing(15, 255.6)
print("Chair 1 (1 & 14):", intersect_rays(x1_c1, y1_c1, th1_c1, x14_c1, y14_c1, th14_c1))
print("Chair 1 (1 & 15):", intersect_rays(x1_c1, y1_c1, th1_c1, x15_c1, y15_c1, th15_c1))
print("Chair 1 (14 & 15):", intersect_rays(x14_c1, y14_c1, th14_c1, x15_c1, y15_c1, th15_c1))

# 3. TABLE (center brown table)
# Frame 1: u = 222.0
# Frame 8: u = 212.7
# Frame 14: u = 206.3
# Frame 15: u = 365.8
# Frame 19: u = 108.5
x1_t, y1_t, th1_t = get_bearing(1, 222.0)
x14_t, y14_t, th14_t = get_bearing(14, 206.3)
x15_t, y15_t, th15_t = get_bearing(15, 365.8)
x19_t, y19_t, th19_t = get_bearing(19, 108.5)
print("Table (1 & 14):", intersect_rays(x1_t, y1_t, th1_t, x14_t, y14_t, th14_t))
print("Table (1 & 15):", intersect_rays(x1_t, y1_t, th1_t, x15_t, y15_t, th15_t))
print("Table (14 & 15):", intersect_rays(x14_t, y14_t, th14_t, x15_t, y15_t, th15_t))
print("Table (15 & 19):", intersect_rays(x15_t, y15_t, th15_t, x19_t, y19_t, th19_t))

# 4. CHAIR 2 (near sideboard / foreground right in frame 1)
# Frame 1: u = 450.4
# Frame 8: u = 488.3
# Frame 19: u = 444.4
# Frame 20: u = 276.8... wait, in frame 20 what is u around 250?
x1_c2, y1_c2, th1_c2 = get_bearing(1, 450.4)
x8_c2, y8_c2, th8_c2 = get_bearing(8, 488.3)
x19_c2, y19_c2, th19_c2 = get_bearing(19, 444.4)
print("Chair 2 (1 & 8):", intersect_rays(x1_c2, y1_c2, th1_c2, x8_c2, y8_c2, th8_c2))
print("Chair 2 (1 & 19):", intersect_rays(x1_c2, y1_c2, th1_c2, x19_c2, y19_c2, th19_c2))
print("Chair 2 (8 & 19):", intersect_rays(x8_c2, y8_c2, th8_c2, x19_c2, y19_c2, th19_c2))
